stages.name: P0 baseline and governance
acceptance: Research sources and counts are reproducible
Capacity and evolution architecture are documented
Host baseline passes
Program status and risks are machine-checkable
carryover: Record firmware size, minimum heap, and physical-device baseline before stage 2 release

stages.name: Stable identity and save expansion migration
acceptance: Smaller old catalogs decode by stable species ID
New records initialize to UNKNOWN
NVS migration commits and reads back before publication
Future, duplicate, unknown, and corrupt records are rejected
Firmware, render, NVS, and physical-device evidence pass
stages.next_action: Deferred device checks remain unfinished; resume them before claiming full device acceptance. Stage 3 development is authorized by the owner decision dated 2026-09-17.

verification_deferral.decision: Defer Stage 2 device tests, mark verification unfinished, publish to main and start Stage 3. This permits development, not a device acceptance pass.

stages.name: Signed content package and bounded cache
acceptance: Signed manifest rejects corruption
Interrupted update preserves the active package
RAM does not scale with total catalog size
Installed content remains fully offline
stages.next_action: Implement and test the host content-pack format, signing and streaming verification; device provider, storage allocation, atomic activation/rollback and cache remain unfinished.

stages.name: Modular monolith content backend
acceptance: P0 product gate is approved
One million synthetic entries pass
Read load reaches 1000 RPS with P95 below 300 ms
Backup restore and idempotency tests pass

stages.name: Horizontal scale and domain services
acceptance: Stage 4 capacity trigger is observed
One hundred million synthetic entries pass
Read load reaches 10000 RPS with measured linear scaling
Tracing, replay, and failure isolation pass

stages.name: Sharding, multi-region, and federated catalogs
acceptance: Stage 5 single-cluster capacity trigger is observed
One billion synthetic entries pass across shards
Regional RPO and RTO targets pass
Region failure and shard split drills pass
